data.one_liner: A small, fast NTP client for Flutter and Dart with built-in offset caching.
data.what_it_does: Fetches accurate time from Network Time Protocol (NTP) servers using pure Dart. It caches the offset between the device and the server so subsequent time lookups are instant.
use_when: You need accurate, synchronized time independent of the device's local clock.
Your app requires offline fallback support while attempting to sync with an NTP server.
avoid_when: You are targeting Flutter Web (UDP is not supported on the web platform).
strengths: Pure Dart with no platform channels required.
Built-in caching for instant subsequent time reads.
Includes 40+ public NTP servers by default.
weaknesses: Does not support Flutter Web due to lack of UDP support.
